q: True or false: The operating room is kept at negative 10 Pa.
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-OR-RDS-04B
n: +10 to protect (OR), −10 to contain (isolation). Remember this: "+10 to protect, −10 to contain." Operating and delivery rooms push air OUT (+10 Pa) to keep germs away from the patient; isolation rooms pull air IN (−10 Pa) to keep germs away from everyone else. Most rooms: 23°C, 50% RH, 93–99% filtration at 1 micron. Word root: isolation = Latin insula "island".
